description: One-way XlCo query-to-candidate contrastive classification over caller-supplied [B,C] raw dot-product scores, using the positive index per row and no normalization or temperature; InfoXLM Section 3.3, Eqs. (5)-(6).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": int(ctx.index) % 4}
ds = synth.Spec("infoxlm-candidate-scores", generator=samples, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=4)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "infoxlm"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train candidate scores with InfoXLM XlCo loss

name: InfoXLM XlCo contrastive loss

parameters.ignore_index: optional integer target value excluded from reductions; ignored rows return zero
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point raw query-candidate score tensor shaped [B, C]
parameters.reduction: none per row, mean over nonignored rows, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer positive-candidate indices shaped [B] in [0, C), except ignore_index
